import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import hashlib,json,pathlib
corpus=pathlib.Path('/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus')
ids=[341444,334183,334728,319113,319212,367700,364265,356524,317625,376715]
files=sorted(corpus.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl'))
recs={}
for f in files:
    b=f.read_bytes()
    for i,ln in enumerate(b.split(b'\n')):
        if not ln: continue
        try: o=json.loads(ln)
        except Exception: continue
        if o.get('mathdb_id') in ids:
            recs[o['mathdb_id']]=(f,i+1,ln)
for sid in ids:
    f,i,ln=recs[sid]
    o=json.loads(ln)
    txt=ln.decode('utf-8')
    key='"statement"'
    pos=txt.index(key)
    start=pos+len(key)
    while txt[start] in ' :': start+=1
    dec=json.JSONDecoder()
    tok,end=dec.raw_decode(txt,start)
    rawtok=txt[start:end].encode('utf-8')
    print('='*70)
    print('ID',sid,'line1',i+1,'raw_sha256',hashlib.sha256(ln).hexdigest())
    print('raw_statement_token_sha256',hashlib.sha256(rawtok).hexdigest(),'token_len',len(rawtok))
    print('decoded_statement_sha256',hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),'len',len(o['statement']))
    print('title',o.get('title'))
    print('post_type',o.get('post_type'),'status',o.get('status'),'completeness',o.get('statement_completeness'),'solutions',o.get('solution_count'))
    print('source_name',o.get('source_name'))
    print('source_url',o.get('source_url'))
    print('references',o.get('references'))
    print('STATEMENT:')
    print(o['statement'])
